messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER — P1 alert for HelioHealth (private VPC, dedicated pool eu-west-1): multiple inference endpoints showing elevated 502/504 and target health flapping on NLB. Automatic runbook triggered: https://rb.redwood/runbooks/vpc-nlb-healthcheck (paging @oncall-amber)
oncall-amber: ack — I'm on it. pulling metrics/logs now. what pool id is affected and any customer-visible error pages?
net-raj: pool id rdp-helio-eu-2. Observed: NLB started preserving client source IP after a recent kernel module update on the host pool. Our SGs were scoped to the SNATed host IP ranges; health probes now present with original client IPs and are being dropped by SG.
kyle-wu: confirming with target group dump: target health = UNHEALTHY, reason shows TCP RST on handshake. Conntrack counters on hosts spike (established->time_wait). Quick tcpdump shows many SYN->RST pairs.
mira-ops: starting temporary mitigations: 1) add SG ingress to allow NLB probe CIDR 10.0.240.0/22 to health port range, 2) toggle proxy protocol setting on the NLB to match expected behavior.
oncall-amber: doing SG change now. Command: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 1024-65535 --cidr 10.0.240.0/22` — applied, waiting for propagation.
se-sam: routing policy: shifting 30% of production traffic for HelioHealth to the hosted fallback (redwood/gpt-xxl-hosted) to reduce customer impact while infra stabilizes.
net-raj: also kicking rolling restart of redwood-agent on pool nodes to clear conntrack table: `for n in $(nodes); do ssh $n sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference && sleep 20; done` — doing one at a time.
kyle-wu: after SG applied and two node restarts, healthchecks showing GREEN on 6/8 targets. 502 rate across the service dropped from ~28% to ~3% in last 5m.
oncall-amber: good. I'm patching the kernel-gate checklist to prevent future auto-updates without conntrack validation.
se-sam: notified HelioHealth POC: short status note sent, they reported degraded UX but acceptable during mitigation window. Asked for ETA — gave 15-30m.
product-lina: add to follow-up: verify default SG templates for private VPCs assume SNAT behavior; if kernel upgrades can flip source IP preservation we need defensive rules.
mira-ops: creating a short-lived automation to detect source IP mismatches in healthchecks and auto-insert emergency SG rule for affected customers.
oncall-amber: monitoring. will keep shift to hosted fallback for 30m then re-evaluate. opening ticket #RD-3456 for postmortem and runbook updates.
incidents-bot: Incident update: P1 -> Mitigated (symptoms reduced & health stable). Follow-ups queued: RD-3456 (postmortem), RB-78 (runbook update), infra-change request to lock kernel auto-updates for dedicated pools.
